name: legacy-code
description: Michael Feathers's Working Effectively with Legacy Code as a Claude Code toolkit: skills, subagents and output styles for characterization tests, seams, dependency breaking, sprout and wrap, and changing untested code in small, verified steps.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short Working Effectively with Legacy Code rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
